newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain April accum budget deficit 0.7 pct/GDP.
newsitem.headline: Spain April accum budget deficit 0.7 pct/GDP.

text.p: Spain's accumulated deficit from January until the end of April on a national account basis was 554.7 billion pesetas, the economy ministry said on Wednesday.
That represented 0.7 percent of gross domestic product, the economy ministry said in a statement.
The national account basis is the accounting measure which is relevant for Maastricht Treaty requirements for participation in the single currency.
The statement also said that on an accumulated cash basis until end-April, the deficit was 454 billion pesetas, 30 percent wider than a year-ago.

The Economy Ministry also said that the cash surplus in the month of April was 407.4 billion pesetas, 46 percent above the amount registered a month earlier, when Spain had a cash surplus of 279.1 billion pesetas.
